column3: BSB adds “If it could” and “felt the guilt.”
BSB renders “Behold I have come” as “Here I am … I have come.”
BSB follows the critical text without “O God,” which the Textus Receptus adds.
BSB adds “Priest” and links “for all time” to the sacrifice.
BSB renders “through the veil, that is, His flesh” as “the curtain of His body.”
BSB renders “the confession of our hope” as “the hope we profess.”
Close to the Greek; BSB follows the critical text without “says the Lord.”
